name: ONKAR KOTULE
headline: Software Development Engineer | Mendix Developer| Full-Stack (MERN, Azure)

professional_summary.content: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise applications using Siemens Mendix and modern full-stack technologies. Skilled in application design, domain modeling, microflows, nanoflows, security, workflow automation, REST integrations, and production support. Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable low-code solutions across logistics, compliance, and transportation domains.

responsibilities: Designed, developed, configured, and supported enterprise-scale applications using Mendix and React, supporting complex business workflows and compliance-driven systems, Support junior members.
Built end-to-end Mendix applications including domain models, microflows, nanoflows, integrations, and Mendix security.
Integrated external REST APIs and backend services into Mendix applications.

projects.title: ShareSpace - Document Management System
bullet_points: Architected from scratch an enterprise-grade document management platform tailored for secure, file storage and business-unit collaboration.
Engineered a hierarchical data structure within the domain model to seamlessly organize complex directory trees and file systems.
Implemented secure data lifecycle controls, leveraging the FileDocument system to manage high-performance uploads/downloads alongside customized soft-delete (Trash) and permanent purge workflows.
Enforced rigid security baselines by building complex entity and attribute-level access criteria using XPath to strictly govern document visibility across user roles.
Contributed actively to refinement sessions and sprint planning, collaborated with business stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements.
Integrated the application into CI/CD pipelines, enabling reliable builds and controlled deployments across environments.

projects.title: Export Control
bullet_points: Enhanced And Implemented an Export Control Compliance system in Mendix to automate regulatory validations.
Refactored existing ECCN logic into a configuration-driven design, making ECCNs and COO rules easy to understand, modify, and maintain.
Built dynamic validation microflows for export restrictions with secure, auditable, and role-based access control.
